integrity: Exact finite-field character sums and equality in the disk bound establish the claims analytically. The supplied finite numerical cross-check concerns the canonical construction.
scientific_limitations: For q>2k only necessary equality constraints and an example of nonsymmetric optimizers are given, not a complete classification.
Concurrent linear pencils only, 2<=k<=q; k=q+1 has trivial uniform zero bias.
Nonnegative probability weights; signed or complex measures not included.
The numerical minimax value is not claimed as novel; the contribution concerns equality without symmetry assumptions.
title: Equality cases for Fourier bias on incomplete finite-field line pencils
